# Remotfix

> Remotfix (remotfix.in) — "REMOTE IT SOLUTIONS & SUPPORT". Enterprise IT Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) covering corporate workstations, structured network racks, and bare-metal/cloud servers alongside encrypted 24/7 remote troubleshooting.

Remotfix is launching a unified enterprise IT support and Annual Maintenance Contract platform. Businesses can request custom AMC proposals or reach our engineering desk directly at [support@remotfix.in](mailto:support@remotfix.in).

## Core Website & Services

- [Remotfix Homepage & Launch Countdown](https://remotfix.in/): Main pre-launch portal featuring company mission, live countdown timer, and early-access notification signup.
- [Workstations & Laptops AMC](https://remotfix.in/#amc-services): Lifecycle maintenance for Windows, macOS, and Linux fleets including OS patch hygiene, thermal deep-cleaning, and anti-ransomware protection (< 15m remote SLA).
- [Network Racks & Cabling AMC](https://remotfix.in/#amc-services): Structured Cat6A and fiber cabling, TIA-568-C rack dressing, Cisco/Fortinet/Ubiquiti firewall management, and 24/7 uplink monitoring.
- [Dedicated Servers & Cloud AMC](https://remotfix.in/#amc-services): Bare-metal and hypervisor administration (Proxmox, VMware ESXi, Windows Server), RAID health monitoring, and immutable 3-2-1 backup verification (99.99% uptime SLA).
- [SLA & Security Standards](https://remotfix.in/#advantages): Overview of instant remote triage, quarterly hardware/network security audits, encrypted remote tunnels, and fixed transparent pricing.
- [Enterprise Contact Desk](https://remotfix.in/#contact): Direct engineering inquiry desk at [support@remotfix.in](mailto:support@remotfix.in) serving Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, and global remote clients.

## Machine-Readable Discovery & Sitemaps

- [XML Sitemap](https://remotfix.in/sitemap.xml): Search engine sitemap indexing canonical URLs and service visual assets.
- [Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD)](https://remotfix.in/.well-known/ard.json): Standardized JSON resource catalog for autonomous AI agents.
- [AI Catalog Manifest](https://remotfix.in/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Legacy-compatible ARD catalog manifest endpoint.
- [Robots Policy](https://remotfix.in/robots.txt): Universal search engine and AI crawler access policy.
- [Security Policy](https://remotfix.in/.well-known/security.txt): RFC 9116 security contact and vulnerability disclosure policy.
